description:
A hospital IT security administrator is setting up access control for a new triage module. You need to create a new privilege in the OpenMRS Administration panel.

Navigate to the OpenMRS Administration panel and create a new privilege with the following details:

- Privilege Name: View Triage Queue
- Description: Allows users to view the patient triage queue and priority levels

The OpenMRS admin panel is accessible at: https://localhost/openmrs/admin
Login credentials: username 'superman', password 'Admin123'

After creating the privilege, it should appear in the Manage Privileges list.
